entities.name: Stocking Frame (Knitting Machine)
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: William Lee's stocking frame mechanized knitting, producing stockings 10x faster than hand knitting. Queen Elizabeth I refused a patent, fearing unemployment. It was the first step toward textile industrialization.
